breaking_news.headline: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
breaking_news.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

breaking_news.headline: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
breaking_news.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
breaking_news.summary: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia tries to get back to business
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia quarterly earnings are in. But the biggest question isn't about past business performance it's about the company's future leadership.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia needs more than a new CEO. An expert offers a way forward
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia needs a new CEO. Keeping its engineers is another story.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia hold first earnings call since former CEO's departure
breaking_news.summary: Chip giant Nvidia held its first earnings call since the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang, as interim CEO Colette Kress takes over.

breaking_news.headline: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
breaking_news.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
breaking_news.summary: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
breaking_news.summary: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

breaking_news.headline: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russia says
breaking_news.summary: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.

breaking_news.headline: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
breaking_news.summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.

breaking_news.headline: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
breaking_news.summary: No state has ever been found guilty by an international court of committing genocide.

breaking_news.headline: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
breaking_news.summary: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

breaking_news.headline: This is a remarkable diplomatic moment for China's Xi - but it comes with pitfalls
breaking_news.summary: The meeting comes with challenges as there are things Xi does not appear keen to discuss with Putin and Trump.

breaking_news.headline: Gilts v kilts: What is happening with Scottish government bonds?
breaking_news.summary: MSPs have heard both the pros and cons of the government's plan to launch its first ever bond to the market.

breaking_news.headline: Elon Musk says record $446m spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'
breaking_news.summary: The multi-billionaire also said he was "not Maga", distancing himself from the political movement linked to Trump.

breaking_news.headline: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
breaking_news.summary: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.

breaking_news.headline: Crew unaware of risks before Mike Lynch's yacht Bayesian sank, say investigators
breaking_news.summary: The vessel sank off the coast of northern Sicily, killing seven people including British tech tycoon Mike Lynch.

breaking_news.headline: The seven Anthropic founders who are about to become multi-billionaires
breaking_news.summary: The AI company behind Claude is about to sell its shares on the US stock market - making its founders very rich.

breaking_news.headline: Simon Jack: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
breaking_news.summary: Anthropic's hotly anticipated IPO is expected to put it in the top 10 most valuable US companies, but the future is uncertain.
